generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at 1, unique per table; never NULL; never duplicated.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key: Sample only from the parent primary-key pool; include NULL rows (nullable FK) and parent keys with no children; never invent keys outside the parent pool (FK constraint is enforced).
generic_sampling_rules.int_numeric: Uniform integers within the column range; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side; deterministic planting of listed boundary literals.
generic_sampling_rules.real_numeric: Uniform reals within the column range; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side; deterministic planting of listed boundary literals; ties at listed ORDER ranks.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a small pool of realistic strings; include near-variants (case changes, one-character edits) of listed equality/IN literals; allow duplicates on DISTINCT columns (20-50% duplicate share).
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Format 'Month YYYY' (e.g. 'August 2008'); sample months and years within a plausible range; include group sizes 1, 2 and >=3 and ties at listed ORDER ranks.
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: For each nullable column, compute the NULL share from the compact database's original values for that column; plant NULLs in generated rows to match that share, with at least one NULL row per nullable column. NOT NULL/PK columns never NULL. Planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.

targets.require: at least two distinct dates share the maximum count

supporting_evidence.FK_publication_book: publication.Book_ID references book.Book_ID; the FK constraint is enforced, so all non-NULL FK values are drawn from the book.Book_ID pool. Unmatched-join coverage is achieved via parent rows without children and NULL FK rows, not via out-of-pool keys.
supporting_evidence.null_share: The compact database shows 0% NULLs in all nullable columns; the program computes the per-column NULL share from schema.original_values and plants NULLs to match it (at least one NULL row per nullable column).

uncertainty: No calculated column or date-pair order rule is evidenced; Publication_Date is a single text date column with no paired end date. Price boundary literals (5,000,000) are far below observed values; boundary rows are planted deterministically per per_column_exceptions. The unmatched_join_rows target for publication.Book_ID is satisfied by parent rows without children and NULL FK rows only; out-of-pool FK values are not generated because the FK constraint is enforced. The duplicates_for_distinct target on book.Book_ID is dropped because Book_ID is a PRIMARY KEY and cannot have duplicates.
